verdict.rationale: Angular is a frontend framework, not an API service, so a traditional OpenAPI spec doesn't apply—but the probe confirms an llms.txt machine-readable documentation index at angular.dev, which can serve as an 'equivalent' machine-readable spec for AI-native consumption of its docs. Missing for 10: no actual OpenAPI/JSON schema for any Angular API surface, no first-party documentation describing llms.txt as an API spec substitute, no independent corroboration of its completeness or use by agents.
